reviews.title: This is a large cpu cooler that keeps it's cool.
reviews.comment: This is a awesome cpu cooler.  It has a large 5in screen and it's very easy to install. Also you can customize the screen with pictures of your choice. One thing you have to consider is the the size of your pc case. I mean the depth of the inside depth of the case. This cooler is large. I'd recommend it for sure.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Effective with 9850x3d
reviews.comment:
Easy to install, super clean look with an amazing screen.
Keeps my cpu around 70 degrees Celsius under full load.
Software is a bit janky so prepare to go into Windows firewall.
reviews.author: Jonathan Cheek

reviews.title: Slick Cooler!
reviews.comment:
I upgraded to this cooler from using the hyped single fan Sudokoo 700v. So far this puppy is cooling my jets well. Better than the Sudokoo because it has 2 fans and all of the other same features like rail mounting system and a high quality LCD screen.
I only took one star off because of price. I think it could be cheaper and still profitable for this company as they are definitely a Chinese product.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Best air cooler with an LCD screen on the market!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/F1seePwlekL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71sz7jIAPWL._SY256.jpg The cooler was packaged so well from TRYX!  Opened it up and the cooler was massive didn’t expect it to be that huge in a good way! screen is nice and the way the cooler design is elegant and functional. Installation was a breeze and cooling performance for my Intel i5 250kf Plus was good, my cpu idles between 36c to 40c and on medium load rarely goes above 50c.
Definitely buying the white version for another build in the future!
reviews.author: Alan Ventura

reviews.title: Awesome screen with free software!!!
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1edHWa0f0L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/613MJUHJhqL._SY256.jpg Amazing, don’t forget to download and update the Kanali software. A Tryx Kanali installation video on YouTube helped me. This is my first PC and i figured out the physical upgrade on my own. All I’m going to say is it took me 3hrs bc i almost gave up trying to replace the CPU brackets, cleaning and reapplying thermal paste. Not recommended for beginners to do it alone.
